options: A short theme associated with a character or idea
A drum fill at the end of a verse
A chord pattern of twelve bars
questions.why: A leitmotif returns through a film or opera to represent a person or idea.

questions.q: Which chords make up the basic 12-bar blues?
questions.why: 12-bar blues is built from I, IV and V.

questions.q: Music the characters in a film can hear is called:
questions.why: Diegetic music comes from within the film world (radio, band on screen).

questions.q: Describe two ways in which a film composer can create tension.
questions.model: Use a repeated ostinato in low strings or percussion, a gradual crescendo and rising pitch, and dissonant or chromatic chords with tremolo strings.
